mentions.title: King bearings problem
mentions.snippet: Moparts thread titled as a King bearings problem. Surfaced in the spun/out-of-spec search; the complaint detail was not visible in the snippet, so this is flagged on the title alone and not yet characterised.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread: King main thrust bearings made since 2024 are described as out of spec on free spread, so they slip onto the cap and block groove without an interference fit and could spin. Advises inspecting before install.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully: still no King or official reply, thread open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the poster reports receiving in-spec NOS Clevite thrust bearings.
